title: Che Designer Sei?
description: An interactive web experience built for Talent Garden — Europe's largest tech education network — to promote their design courses. Users answer a series of personality-style questions and receive a personalised designer profile with a matching course recommendation.
highlights: Designed and built the full quiz flow with animated transitions between questions
Integrated with HubSpot CMS for lead capture on result pages
Achieved sub-second page load on Vercel's edge network
Shipped end-to-end in under 3 weeks, from brief to production
